f_01KXB19V7YZDHKPSAXF06MJCKG.subject: job_total_estimate
f_01KXB19V7YZDHKPSAXF06MJCKG.content: The cost breakdown for this addition totals $100,778.92 (labor $45,167.59, material $52,171.33, equipment $3,440.00).

f_01KXB19V7YX1SYB6XGYVHDSD4F.subject: job_total_labor_hours
f_01KXB19V7YX1SYB6XGYVHDSD4F.content: The breakdown estimates 1,287 total labor hours across all sections.

f_01KXB19V7ZTGHR3EK76DCA75N2.subject: addition_footprint_sf
f_01KXB19V7ZTGHR3EK76DCA75N2.content: The addition overall footprint is 789 square feet with an 8-foot ceiling height.

f_01KXB19V7ZQTZP5G618P9XV497.subject: addition_dimensions
f_01KXB19V7ZQTZP5G618P9XV497.content: The addition is a two-story structure approximately 30 feet by 10 feet, adding a basement storage area, second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXB19V7ZQF7M63M0BJ79E1VK.subject: scheduled_start_date
f_01KXB19V7ZQF7M63M0BJ79E1VK.content: This job is scheduled to start on 2026-10-05.

f_01KXB19V7ZVV0WVQB4V685Q28Y.subject: addition_septic_exclusion
f_01KXB19V7ZVV0WVQB4V685Q28Y.content: Septic relocation/replacement costs are explicitly excluded from the scope; a TDEC inspection is required and a change order will be needed if septic work is necessary.

f_01KXB19V7ZSHXGCFED8VHC84NV.subject: addition_subpanel_spec
f_01KXB19V7ZSHXGCFED8VHC84NV.content: A 100-amp electrical subpanel is included in the electrical scope.

f_01KXB19V7Z35H4KHHZQGTTN2KM.subject: addition_lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXB19V7Z35H4KHHZQGTTN2KM.content: One 3-ply 14-inch LVL beam spanning approximately 15 feet 6 inches is required to open an existing load-bearing wall; temporary shoring is included in scope.

f_01KXB19V7ZACGGJAHZBHG07Q6H.subject: addition_roof_pitch
f_01KXB19V7ZACGGJAHZBHG07Q6H.content: The new addition gable roof is pitched at approximately 3/12, tying into the existing home's 6/12 pitch roof.

f_01KXB19V7ZMG9XS6A639488NX3.subject: addition_elevator_shaft
f_01KXB19V7ZMG9XS6A639488NX3.content: A 4-by-4-foot elevator shaft is framed into the addition; the elevator system itself is excluded from scope, but a dedicated 120V/30A circuit is included in the electrical scope.

f_01KXB19V7Z6WDGKCWVSJ59M1Q4.subject: addition_windows_spec
f_01KXB19V7Z6WDGKCWVSJ59M1Q4.content: The addition includes four windows: three 36-inch by 60-inch units and one transom window.

f_01KXB19V7Z35F22F108R4126ZY.subject: addition_architect
f_01KXB19V7Z35F22F108R4126ZY.content: Architectural drawings for the Simons Addition were prepared by Francisco Guerrero, NCIDQ (Interior Architect).

f_01KXB19V8096N662Y585KEXNX5.subject: retrofit_section_negative_cost
f_01KXB19V8096N662Y585KEXNX5.content: The breakdown section 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' carries a -$4,199.00 material cost and a -$1,714.20 section total — the only section in the breakdown with a negative grand total.

f_01KXB19V80RAJV6MCX5K5WZW9W.subject: addition_exterior_finish
f_01KXB19V80RAJV6MCX5K5WZW9W.content: New vinyl siding is specified to match the existing home; brick veneer at the base of the addition must also match the existing brick.
